claim: Attack success probability (ASP) is an attacker-side effectiveness metric of MTD, with Evans et al. as an example.
quote: Our goal is to understand what types of diversity and attacks can be disrupted by such a strategy, and how the rate if re-diversiﬁcation impacts the attacker’s success probability.
locator: p. 34 printed (PDF p. 6), Sec. 2.3; the analysis computes it, e.g. p. 41 printed (PDF p. 13), Sec. 2.5.5: "the quantity of interest is the probability of a successful attack occur- ring in some speciﬁc number of probes"
issue: Survives the adversarial read: Evans et al. measure MTD effectiveness by the attacker's success probability, analytically (models of probing and re-randomisation), in an MTD setting.
